description: Plan v7 §4 W0/S2: src/main.rs, cli.rs, error.rs (AppError, exit 0/1/2), runtime/{coordinator,signals,cleanup}.rs. notes:
S2 done. Files created: src/main.rs (rewritten from the cargo-new stub), src/cli.rs + src/cli_tests.rs, src/error.rs + src/error_tests.rs, src/runtime/{mod,coordinator,signals,cleanup}.rs with sibling coordinator_tests.rs / signals_tests.rs / cleanup_tests.rs, tests/feature_guard.rs, tests/cli_smoke.rs.

Gate edits: .claude/skills/check/SKILL.md and AGENTS.md nextest line now 'nextest run --all-features'. CLAUDE.md is a symlink to AGENTS.md so it inherited the change (no separate edit). SKILL.md gained a paragraph on why --all-features is mandatory (the testing feature compiles the test seams; tests/feature_guard.rs fails the build without it) and a paragraph naming AC38 and AC37 as separate gates.

Tests: 62 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped across three binaries (55 unit in bin/agentctl, 6 tests/cli_smoke, 1 tests/feature_guard). Coverage includes: parse vectors for every subcommand and flag (status/watch/login/accounts list|show|remove|relocate|forget|unforget/import/doctor), duration grammar vectors, AC13 (--interval 30s and 0/1s/59s/59 all rejected with a message containing 60; default 300s; 60s/60/1m/10m accepted), exit-code mapping for every AppError variant plus a never-zero check, AC43 cancellation and deadline halves, cleanup registry semantics.

Overflow handling (C-006, overflow-checks off in every profile): parse_duration uses str::parse (library-level range check) plus checked_mul for m/h. '99999999999999999999s' errors rather than wrapping, asserted with a real assertion in its own test, not a debug_assert. signals::exit_status_for uses checked_add so an absurd signo cannot wrap into a plausible status.

AC43 evidence: a job spawns /bin/sleep 30, hands the Child to the coordinator via PassCtx::register_child, and reports its pid to the test over a handshake channel; the test then cancels and asserts (a) the results drain and the channel disconnects -- which is precisely 'workers joined', since each worker owns one Sender -- within a measured 500 ms of cancellation, (b) the job's wait_child returned ErrorKind::Interrupted, meaning the coordinator killed the child rather than it exiting on its own, and (c) 'ps -p <pid>' is empty, so the child is dead and reaped. The deadline half asserts the same with no cancellation, measuring the overrun past the deadline. Both pass (0.024s and 0.324s).

Design note worth carrying into W1: the coordinator owns every Child handle in a Mutex<ChildTable> so the watchdog can kill on cancel/deadline, while the worker keeps the child's pipes (taken before register_child) and waits through PassCtx::wait_child, which polls at 10 ms instead of blocking so the watchdog can always take the lock. Cancel is Arc<AtomicBool> + Mutex + Condvar so waiters wake immediately on cancel rather than at the end of a poll interval.

CLI deviation, needs a nod from the lead: plan 3.2 calls --config-dir global, but a clap global arg propagates into every subcommand and collides at build time with 'import --config-dir <dir>...', which means something different (foreign Claude Code dirs to scan). So the top-level one is non-propagating: 'agentctl --config-dir DIR claude status' works, 'agentctl claude status --config-dir DIR' does not; AGENTCTL_CONFIG_DIR covers the ergonomic case. cli_tests::clap_command_definition_is_internally_consistent calls Cli::command().debug_assert(), which is what catches this class of collision.

AC38 evidence: 'cargo check --tests' with no features fails with exactly 'error: agentctl e2e tests require --all-features (see /check)' at tests/feature_guard.rs:16, exit 101. The same command with --all-features finishes clean, exit 0. The guard is in its own always-compiled file because tests/cli_smoke.rs carries an inner #![cfg(feature = "testing")], which would have deleted a compile_error! placed inside it.

Dead-code suppression: error.rs, runtime/coordinator.rs and runtime/cleanup.rs carry a module-level #![cfg_attr(not(test), expect(dead_code, reason = "..."))]. expect not allow, so it starts warning the moment W1 gives these items a caller; scoped to not(test) because the sibling tests do exercise them and an unfulfilled expect would itself fail the -D warnings gate.

Hygiene: zero .unwrap() anywhere in src/, tests included (rg clean). No TODO/HACK/FIXME/dbg!/println!. No test-only env name appears in src/ at all. Nothing was written outside the repo tree and the session scratchpad; no keychain, ~/.claude, ~/.config/agentctl or live-config-dir access.

Gate result, all three green: cargo fmt --check exit 0; cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings exit 0; cargo nextest run --all-features exit 0, 62 passed. Two clippy findings were fixed rather than suppressed: manual_unwrap_or in exit_status_for, and never_loop on the signal iterator (the loop body always exits the process, so it now takes the first signal via .next()).

Environment caveat: the two defects recorded on agentctl-s1-cargo-deps-ygw are still live, so the gate was run with CARGO_TARGET_DIR pointed at the session scratchpad instead of --config config.dev.toml, and with the stable toolchain's bin dir prepended to PATH for fmt. Both are invocation-only; nothing in the repo depends on them.

Left undone deliberately: the check skill still says nextest reporting 'no tests to run' is expected while the crate is the cargo-new skeleton. That is now false (62 tests), but the brief said to change only the nextest line and the two new paragraphs, so it is flagged rather than edited.

(2) check skill: stale 'no tests to run is expected' line replaced. (3) Gate re-run verbatim by the lead with the fixed env: fmt 0, clippy -D warnings 0, nextest --all-features 63/63, no-feature check --tests fails with the feature_guard compile_error (AC38). Commits a9e812e (S1), d6e2a6f (S2) pushed to origin/main. Untracked scaffolding (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md symlink, .claude/, README.md) carries the gate edit but is not committed — asked the user at the S3 stop.

description: Plan v7 §4 W0/S3, user-operated with a throwaway account. This throwaway account has extra_usage.is_enabled=true: monthly_limit 500000, used_credits 21956.0, utilization 4.3911999999999995 (0-100 scale, = used/limit*100), currency USD, decimal_places 2, credits_ever_enabled true; spend.enabled=true, used.amount_minor 21956 / limit.amount_minor 500000 (exponent 2), percent 4 (integer), cap.credits{amount_minor 500000}, balance null, auto_reload null. Confirms F23a and the extra_usage<->spend correspondence (utilization rounds to percent). Captured verbatim as fixtures/claude/usage-extra-usage-enabled.json (REAL capture, replaces the planned SYNTHETIC one; AC22's expected vector becomes On{21956 USD e2, Some(500000), Some(4)} — record in S4). No retry-after / ratelimit headers on a single GET.
S3(iii) DONE 2026-09-08 15:03Z: same GET with UA agentctl/0.1.0 -> 200 (2050 B, same shape). DECISION U13: default User-Agent for /api/oauth/usage = agentctl/<version>; AGENTCTL_CLAUDE_USER_AGENT may override (e.g. to the Claude Code UA). Token-endpoint UA is a separate question (see (i)); added probe (vi) 'refresh' with the honest UA to run after (v).
S3(iv) DONE 2026-09-08 15:04Z: GET /api/oauth/usage with the EXPIRED access token from keychain item 'Claude Code-credentials-5cdc535f' (expiresAt 1787768887840 ms, ~12.9 d past; read-only -w inside the script, nothing written) -> 401 {type: error, error: {type: authentication_error, message: 'OAuth access token has expired. Re-authenticate to continue.'}, request_id: null}. Confirms the 401 (not 403) refresh-once path. (v) poll and (vi) refresh-UA probe pending (user-run).
S3(v) DONE 2026-09-08 15:06-15:15Z: ten GETs at 60 s intervals with UA agentctl/0.1.0 -> 10/10 HTTP 200, 2050 B each; NO retry-after, NO ratelimit/x-ratelimit/anthropic-ratelimit headers at all (header set: date, content-type, request-id, cf-ray, cf-cache-status, server, server-timing, vary, strict-transport-security, content-security-policy, x-robots-tag, anthropic-organization-id, anthropic-workspace-id). Retires the polling half of F12/U9 at 60 s cadence for one account; P4's 300 s cache + 60 s floor stand as designed. NOTE: the usage response carries anthropic-organization-id / anthropic-workspace-id headers (identity evidence from the wire; not needed in phase 1). S3(vi) DONE 15:23Z: POST refresh_token grant (F8 body incl. scope) with UA agentctl/0.1.0 -> 200; response keys identical to exchange (access_token, refresh_token, expires_in 28800, refresh_token_expires_in 2375685, scope = F4 set, token_type, token_uuid, account, organization); refresh_token ROTATED (F8's 'absent -> keep old' still the right fallback, but rotation is the observed norm); refresh_token_expires_in is anchored to the original login (2377445 at exchange -> 2375685 ~30 min later), not reset by rotation.
